title: Telemarketing Sales Rule: 5 Years of Records, Not Two
meta_description: Since 16 May 2024 the Telemarketing Sales Rule has required most records to be kept 5 years. On 13 Nov 2026 the FTC’s guide still said two. What to keep.

image.takeaway: Since 16 May 2024 the Telemarketing Sales Rule requires most records to be kept 5 years, not two.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on the Telemarketing Sales Rule: since 16 May 2024, 16 CFR 310.5 requires most telemarketing records to be kept for 5 years, while the FTC’s business guide still says two years.
